blog_llms_txt_guide_llmstxt_official_sta.question: Is llms.txt an official standard?
blog_llms_txt_guide_llmstxt_official_sta.answer: No. It is a community proposal that some AI tools support. It is low-cost to add but carries no guarantee of use.

blog_llms_txt_guide_where_i_put.question: Where do I put llms.txt?
blog_llms_txt_guide_where_i_put.answer: At the root of your domain, so it is reachable at yourdomain.com/llms.txt, served as plain text or markdown.

blog_llms_txt_guide_llmstxt_block_ai.question: Does llms.txt block AI training?
blog_llms_txt_guide_llmstxt_block_ai.answer: No. Access control belongs in robots.txt via user-agent directives such as GPTBot and Google-Extended.

blog_llms_txt_guide_long_should_llmstxt.question: How long should llms.txt be?
blog_llms_txt_guide_long_should_llmstxt.answer: Usually under 100 lines. Curate your best pages rather than duplicating your sitemap.

blog_llms_txt_guide_should_i_keep.question: Should I keep it updated?
blog_llms_txt_guide_should_i_keep.answer: Yes — review quarterly and whenever you launch a major service page, so the file reflects your current best content.
